name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name; domain 'battle' fits (read by combat-hit cinematic, full combat cinematic, and audio SFX gate). 'scripted_cinematic_mode' is the primary semantic confirmed in all sites; '_or_terrain_idx' is justified, not an address remnant: the Ghidra plate and code confirm the non-zero value is reused as the forced spotlight/split-bg terrain index in fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic (dual-purpose). No hex address remnant (0x540FF != suffix). Name implicitly reflects scalar flag/index datatype.
purpose: Dual-purpose scripted-cinematic mode flag and forced terrain-index latch for the full combat cinematic; zero in the normal battle path, non-zero enables scripted mode and is reused as the forced spotlight/split-bg terrain index.
logic_summary: Zero-init .bss u32. Writers: fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic (aniend.c) stores per-duel scripted-outcome table value before each credit-roll combat re-enactment; fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic (anicine.c) latches it to 1 after running the scripted counter (ch25 scripted event also sets it). Readers: fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic gates cache free/terrain lookup/counter logic on ==0 vs forces spotlight_terrain/banner_idx from the value when !=0; fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic forces the combat-outcome block (miss/crit/poison/double/damage) to zero when !=0 and returns early when ==1 on the final hit; fd2_play_sfx_with_handle and fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank include ==0 in their SFX-enable gate (so SFX are muted during scripted/tutorial cinematics).
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar. 0 = normal in-game combat (SFX on, real RNG outcome, real terrain lookup, normal counter); non-zero = scripted-cinematic/tutorial mode (SFX muted, outcomes forced 0) AND the value itself is the forced spotlight/split-bg terrain index; latched to 1 by fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic during the scripted counter.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but understated the reader set: it described only the writers and omitted the audio SFX-mute readers (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle / fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank) and fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic outcome-zeroing, and did not state that the non-zero value doubles as the forced terrain index.
notes: Memory at 0x540FF reads all-zero (rest state, .bss). Ghidra data plate at 0x540FF already comprehensive and consistent with src understanding (dual-purpose mode flag / forced terrain-index latch, full writer+reader list incl. audio mute gate), so left unchanged. WRITE xrefs from game code (0x28ef1, 0x2c2a0) => non-const. No logic changed; only the anicine.c comment block above the definition was augmented via Edit.
